_readme: Conformance corpus for the memory record schema (PRD-017 FR-3/FR-4, watch item W12).
The TypeScript parser and the stdlib validator cannot import each other: the validator
runs in repositories where the package is not installed. This file is their entire
contract. Every case is executed against BOTH, and against the shipped practices copy;
a case whose outcomes disagree fails the suite.
The expectation is deliberately implementation-neutral: `valid`, plus for an invalid
case the FIELD names expected to be flagged. Messages are free to differ; agreement on
what is wrong is the contract, agreement on wording is not.
`structure` is the field name for a problem that belongs to no single key (a missing
fence, an unparseable line, a block list).
Coverage matrix — every field crossed with every failure mode it can exhibit. Adding a
Coverage matrix — every field crossed with every failure mode it can exhibit. EVERY cell
must be claimed by at least one case's `matrix` array, and the suite asserts that; a cell
with no case is how two parsers 'agree' while proving nothing.
